name: Calypso AI
what_it_does: AI security and governance platform with attention to enterprise policy enforcement and inspection of inputs/outputs across managed and SaaS AI tools. Heritage in U.S. public-sector AI assurance.
what_it_doesnt_do: Coverage and depth vary by category; do not assume parity with the largest established AI security vendors in every dimension. Like other category leaders, expect feature roadmap, not finished product, for newest threat categories.
best_for: Public-sector and regulated enterprise buyers prioritizing governance integration
not_for: Teams looking for OSS or a research-grade evaluation harness
